name: AMC & maintenance
summary: Regular cleaning and check-ups that help your equipment run reliably.
description: Dust, heat and long running hours slowly reduce cooling and raise power bills. Our Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) schedule periodic servicing so problems are caught early. They suit homes with several units as well as offices, shops and facilities that cannot afford downtime.
suitable_for: Homes with several units, offices, shops, clinics and facilities
includes: Electrical checks and gas pressure readings
Service records for every unit on site
signs: You have several ACs to keep running
Your business can't afford cooling downtime
Units haven't been serviced in over a year

options.name: Non-comprehensive AMC
options.detail: Scheduled servicing; parts charged as needed

options.name: Comprehensive AMC
options.detail: Servicing plus most parts covered under the contract

options.name: Commercial / multi-site AMC
options.detail: Plans built around your units and running hours

process.title: Site audit
process.text: We list every unit, its condition and running hours.

process.title: Plan
process.text: We propose visit frequency and coverage that fit your usage and budget.

process.title: Scheduled visits
process.text: Technicians clean, check and record each unit on schedule.

process.title: Priority support
process.text: AMC customers get priority response for breakdowns.

faqs.question: How many visits does an AMC include?
faqs.answer: Homes typically have 2 – 4 visits a year. Commercial units that run long hours often need servicing every 2 – 3 months.

faqs.question: Comprehensive or non-comprehensive?
faqs.answer: Comprehensive costs more upfront but covers most parts. Non-comprehensive is cheaper, with parts charged when needed.
